(apparently some mythological allusion, see Di Che, to giant bound in skies; compare Homer ' Ωρίωνα δοκεύει , and σθέηος Ὠρίωνος ); both times associated with the Pleiades; suffix כְּסִילֵיהֶם their Orions Isa 13:10 , Orion and other constellations of the same brilliancy.
